text:
Tamara (Sales): ACME wants to shrink their Dedicated POC pool for the upcoming demo to avoid unnecessary spend. Pool id: ded-poc-acme-21. Current commit: min_capacity=28, burst_window=120m. Request: min_capacity=8, burst_window=25m, ephemeral burst credits=80 for the live demo only. They also need a short-lived API key locked to their VPC CIDR. Can infra provide an ephemeral overlay instead of changing the reservation? Need a yes/no and estimate by EOD.

Diego (Infra): Short answer: yes, with caveats. We can't change the committed reservation without 24h lead, but we can apply a quota overlay (ephemeral headroom) and attach ephemeral burst credits. Billing for any overage during the overlay will be invoiced as overage. Burst window 25m OK; recommend cooldown 12m to avoid autoscaler thrash.

Holly (Eng): Proposed quick config for ded-poc-acme-21: min_capacity=8, burst_window=25m, cooldown=12m, fallback_route=hosted-small, ephemeral_credits=80. Also add alerting: sustained >75% for 4m -> page on-call. I'll author a 1-page runbook with rollback commands.

ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket POC-6278 for pool ded-poc-acme-21. Status: awaiting-sales-approval.

oliver-acme (ACME): We accept potential overage for the demo and agree to TTL=48h for the ephemeral key. VPC CIDR: 203.0.113.0/24.

Tamara (Sales): Sales approves ephemeral credits and billing exposure limited to the demo window. ACME confirmed CIDR and TTL. Diego, schedule change at T-2h and post runbook here.

Diego (Infra): Implementation steps: 1) Create ephemeral API key name "acme-demo-ephemeral" TTL=48h with IP restriction to 203.0.113.0/24. 2) Apply quota overlay to ded-poc-acme-21 at T-2h before demo and attach 80 ephemeral credits. 3) Configure routing fallback to hosted-small with tail-latency threshold 300ms. 4) Add alerting rules and page policy. Estimated ops time: 45-75 minutes.

Holly (Eng): Rollback snippet for on-call:
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/dedicated/pools/ded-poc-acme-21 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"min_capacity":28,"burst_window":"120m","cooldown":"30m"}'
Include in runbook: exact ticket link, who to page, and the rollback command.

ops-bot: [automated] POC-6278 status -> scheduled. Change window: 2026-06-12T13:00Z -> 2026-06-12T15:00Z.

Tamara (Sales): Thanks team. I'll confirm demo time with ACME and update this thread when confirmed. :thumbsup:

oliver-acme (ACME): Great, appreciate the flexibility. See you at the demo.
